entities.name: Josef Blösche
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josef Blösche was a German war criminal and a member of the Nazi Party who served in the SS and SD during World War II. Blösche personally executed many Jews, participated in several massacres, and helped send many more to their deaths in extermination camps.
